Name: Friendship Rabbit Foot Events
Author: AirynS
Description:
In vanilla, there's a pair of events where the player gets caught and confronted if dating all of the bachelors or bachelorettes. If you have a rabbit's foot in your inventory though, these events are instead replaced by a friendly event with all of the bachelors or bachelorettes. This mod makes it possible to see those friendly events if you have max friendship with all of the bachelors or bachelorettes instead, so that people who don't want to date everyone can still see them.

This mod doesn't change the text of the events, so it's compatible with all default game languages! It should be compatible with all other mods unless they edit the same events.

The portraits and sprites in the screenshots are from [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/modpacks/8013]Diverse Stardew Valley.[/url]

Downloads.Description: The main file. To install, extract the [CP] Friendship Rabbit Foot Events folder into your Mods folder.
